snippet.title: The Hat Man - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4347270/The_Hat_Man/
Wishlist on Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/the-hat-man-cb045e

A first-person psychological horror game inspired by The Hat Man urban legend, focusing on sleep paralysis, fear, and terror of being unable to move.

Survive escalating sleep paralysis encounters using breathing, blinking, and eye contact. Every mistake brings The Hat Man closer.

Multiple endings. Free to play.

Coming June 30th, 2026.

Also coming soon to:
GameJolt: https://gamejolt.com/games/thehatman/1053342
itch.io: https://blacklanternentertainment.itch.io/the-hat-man
